name: gemini
specialty: Large-context reader suited to builder work, review, and independent second opinions on broad changes.
notes: Give it work as files: write the diff or brief to a file in a directory, pass that directory as --add-dir ({addDir}), and run it from the target repo it must read. Headless agy denied read_file outside its cwd even with --add-dir for other repos.
Headless agy auto-denies every shell ("command") permission, so never ask it to run commands; say so in the prompt and have the lead run tests.
Plan mode means the builder seat returns a proposed change as text; the lead applies it inside the builder's file set and commits.
--print-timeout is set explicitly (15m) so a stuck turn ends; agy's default 0s waits forever.
Status: agy --version. Models: agy models. The Antigravity IDE (handoff) is the separate antigravity profile.
